'''Hyper-eros''' was a condition suffered by some [[Lyunesi]]. Due to their sensitivity to language and body-language, some Lyunesi became consumed with a passion for individuals that deprived them of their rationality. The [[comm handler]] [[Oph Nar Dinnid]] suffered from hyper-eros while working for the supreme liege-lord of the [[Narrant system/Legends|Narrant system]] and was caught in a compromising situation with the liege-lord's alpha concubine.
